result:
I restyled `component.html` in place to the new Harbor brand. The content and layout are unchanged. I haven't opened it in a browser, so I haven't looked at the result.

- **Colors:** I swapped the old blue-and-white palette for the new one.
  - The page is linen (`#F4EFE6`) and the tiles and feed are card color (`#FBF8F2`).
  - Text is forest ink (`#1E2B24`), with muted green-grey (`#5E6B63`) for secondary text.
  - Borders use sand (`#E9E1D2`).
  - Hover and the current nav link use the accent tint (`#F6DFD0`).
  - The feed bullets use the burnt-orange accent (`#C2410C`).
- **Type:**
  - Headlines (the brand name, page title, section heading and stat values) now use Fraunces at weight 400.
  - The page title is no longer all caps.
  - Everything else uses Instrument Sans.
  - The 12px all-caps labels keep their 0.14em letter-spacing, and all other sizes and letter-spacing were already on the brand scale.
- **Shapes:** The tiles and feed card are now 6px radius, and the nav links are 4px instead of pills. The feed bullets are 2px-radius squares instead of circles, because the brand allows no pills.
- **Motion:** Nav hover now takes 120ms on the brand curve.

I kept the current nav link in ink text on the tint, not the orange accent. Orange on that tint comes to about 4.4:1, just under the 4.5:1 minimum.

The file doesn't load the Fraunces or Instrument Sans fonts, so it falls back to Georgia and Helvetica unless the fonts are installed or loaded elsewhere.
